beal-opera-8-5-mm: Thin, light rope for multipitch and ice; the sheath fuzzes for a few.
black-diamond-aspect-pro: All-day crack shoe that fits better than a TC Pro; some delaminated.
black-diamond-atc-pilot: Smooth feeding and lowering at good value; slips on some ropes.
black-diamond-solution-guide-harness: Room for a big trad rack; a couple wore out within two years.
black-diamond-solution-harness: Easy to forget it's on; size carefully for big thighs.
butora-gomi: Sticky, secure heel for wide feet; cramped toes, soft for edging.
butora-rubicon: Very comfortable and great on slab; poor on steep overhangs for one.
edelrid-autana: Adjustable, padded legs for big thighs; the gear loops are tiny.
edelrid-giga-jul: Assisted braking, guide mode and rappels; feeding feels grabby.
edelrid-mega-jul: Light, simple and durable; guide mode is hard and rappels jerky.
edelrid-ohm: Stops lighter belayers being yanked up; the catches are hard.
edelrid-ohmega: Softer catches than the Ohm; some struggle with the settings.
edelrid-pinch: Smooth belaying off the belay loop; drags on thick gym ropes.
evolv-defy-lace: Comfortable, good-value warm-up shoe; too tight for one.
evolv-kira: Very comfortable first or all-day pair; too soft for tiny edges.
evolv-kronos: Good first pair for wide feet; the heel is baggy for a few.
la-sportiva-kubo: A good step up once broken in; the first sessions hurt.
la-sportiva-skwama: Roomy toes and good heel hooks; wears out within months.
misty-mountain-cadillac: Plush trad harness with many gear loops; heavy for some.
organic-big-pad: Large, stiff and durable for solo bouldering; heavy to carry.
petzl-aquila: Five gear loops and adjustable legs; pinchy on the hips for one.
petzl-corax: Two buckles suit big hips or thighs; uncomfortable when hanging.
petzl-luna: Padded, adjustable fit for big thighs; gear loops suit sport.
petzl-neox: Pays out like a tube for lead; it can lock up on thick ropes.
petzl-selena: Comfortable for sport and gym; a few had off-centre gear loops.
petzl-sitta: Light, packs small and holds a trad rack; hanging comfort varies.
scarpa-drago: Soft, sensitive and sticky indoors; toes wear through in months.
scarpa-drago-lv: Snug heel for low-volume feet; many report a painful break-in.
scarpa-helix: Comfortable, durable beginner shoe; limited on tiny holds.
scarpa-instinct-vsr: Versatile with good edging and a wide toe box; painful break-in.
scarpa-instinct-vsr-lv: Snug heel for narrow feet; a tough break-in for some.
scarpa-veloce: Soft, sticky gym favourite; it wears fast and the heel is baggy.
scarpa-veloce-l: Very sticky warm-up shoe; the heel bags out, so size down.
tenaya-indalo: Comfortable yet good on edges and hooks; size well down.
tenaya-mastia: Fits wide feet with sensitive stiffness; some wish it lasted longer.
